SELECT DATE_FORMAT(o.CreatedOnUtc, '%Y-%m') AS label, SUM(o.OrderTotal) AS value
FROM `order` o
WHERE o.Deleted = 0
GROUP BY DATE_FORMAT(o.CreatedOnUtc, '%Y-%m')
ORDER BY label
LIMIT 100

SELECT p.Name AS label, SUM(oi.Quantity) AS value
FROM orderitem oi
JOIN `order` o ON oi.OrderId = o.Id
JOIN product p ON oi.ProductId = p.Id
JOIN address a ON o.BillingAddressId = a.Id
WHERE o.Deleted = 0
  AND p.Deleted = 0
GROUP BY oi.ProductId, p.Name
ORDER BY value DESC
LIMIT 5

SELECT p.Name AS label, SUM(oi.PriceExclTax) AS value
FROM orderitem oi
JOIN `order` o ON oi.OrderId = o.Id
JOIN product p ON oi.ProductId = p.Id
JOIN address a ON o.BillingAddressId = a.Id
WHERE o.Deleted = 0
  AND p.Deleted = 0
GROUP BY oi.ProductId, p.Name
ORDER BY value DESC
LIMIT 100

SELECT p.Name AS label
FROM product p
LEFT JOIN (
  SELECT DISTINCT oi.ProductId
  FROM orderitem oi
  JOIN `order` o ON oi.OrderId = o.Id
  WHERE o.Deleted = 0
) sold ON sold.ProductId = p.Id
WHERE sold.ProductId IS NULL
  AND p.ProductTypeId = 5
  AND p.Deleted = 0
ORDER BY p.Name
LIMIT 100

SELECT co.Name AS label, SUM(o.OrderTotal) AS value
FROM `order` o
JOIN address a ON o.BillingAddressId = a.Id
JOIN country co ON a.CountryId = co.Id
WHERE o.Deleted = 0
GROUP BY a.CountryId, co.Name
ORDER BY value DESC
LIMIT 100

SELECT c.Email AS label, SUM(o.OrderTotal) AS value
FROM customer c
JOIN `order` o ON c.Id = o.CustomerId
WHERE o.Deleted = 0
  AND c.Deleted = 0
GROUP BY c.Id, c.Email
ORDER BY value DESC
LIMIT 100

SELECT c.Email AS label, COUNT(*) AS value
FROM customer c
JOIN `order` o ON c.Id = o.CustomerId
WHERE o.Deleted = 0
  AND c.Deleted = 0
GROUP BY c.Id, c.Email
ORDER BY value DESC
LIMIT 100

SELECT COUNT(*) AS value
FROM customer c
JOIN customer_customerrole_mapping ccrm ON c.Id = ccrm.Customer_Id
JOIN customerrole cr ON ccrm.CustomerRole_Id = cr.Id
WHERE c.Deleted = 0
  AND cr.SystemName = 'Registered'
  AND c.CreatedOnUtc >= UTC_TIMESTAMP() - INTERVAL 30 DAY

SELECT p.Name AS label, CASE WHEN p.UseMultipleWarehouses THEN COALESCE((SELECT SUM(pwi.StockQuantity - pwi.ReservedQuantity) FROM productwarehouseinventory pwi WHERE pwi.ProductId = p.Id), 0) ELSE p.StockQuantity END AS value
FROM product p
WHERE p.ManageInventoryMethodId = 1
  AND (CASE WHEN p.UseMultipleWarehouses THEN COALESCE((SELECT SUM(pwi.StockQuantity - pwi.ReservedQuantity) FROM productwarehouseinventory pwi WHERE pwi.ProductId = p.Id), 0) ELSE p.StockQuantity END) <= p.MinStockQuantity
  AND p.Deleted = 0
  AND p.ProductTypeId <> 10
ORDER BY p.MinStockQuantity, p.DisplayOrder, p.Id
LIMIT 100

SELECT CASE o.OrderStatusId WHEN 10 THEN 'Pending' WHEN 20 THEN 'Processing' WHEN 30 THEN 'Complete' WHEN 40 THEN 'Cancelled' ELSE CAST(o.OrderStatusId AS CHAR) END AS label, COUNT(*) AS value
FROM `order` o
WHERE o.Deleted = 0
GROUP BY o.OrderStatusId, label
ORDER BY value DESC
LIMIT 100

SELECT COUNT(*) AS value
FROM `order` o
WHERE o.Deleted = 0
  AND o.OrderStatusId = 10
